sources.title: Custom Guitar Innovations Octavio | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database documents the Custom Guitar Innovations Octavio as a hand-made reproduction of the Tycobrahe Octavia octave-fuzz design. The record says this version was converted to operate on negative-ground power and was designed to emphasize the characteristic octave-up response. It uses selected diodes to shape the octave character and was intended to retain a smoother, more musical response than harsher reproductions. The entry explicitly identifies the model as Custom Guitar Innovations Octavio.
